rules.noise_floor_reference: historical DCC-L fit8k Monitor spread across 2 seeds = 0.0046207; same-math ZINC run-to-run drift documented in zinc_shared_factor_v1 = up to 0.0026 on valid. Two seeds cannot resolve < 0.003 reliably.
rules.PROMISING_READER_BIAS: both A seeds beat both D and historical DCC-L on Locked; A seed-mean Locked MAE is at least 0.003 lower than D seed-mean AND at least 0.003 lower than DCC-L seed-mean; ordinary-molecule (y > -3) seed-mean gain is >= 0.002 vs both D and DCC-L; the top-10-AE removal seed-mean gain keeps the same (positive) sign vs both; and at least one key group (low-support or any-unseen) has A-vs-D and A-vs-DCCL gains > 0 in both seeds with group seed-mean gain >= 0.003
rules.ADDITIVITY_NOT_SUPPORTED: the A local-contribution pathway is collapsed, or A seed-mean Locked MAE is at least 0.003 worse than D, or at least 0.003 worse than historical DCC-L (checked after PROMISING and before CAPACITY_ONLY)
rules.CAPACITY_ONLY: not PROMISING and not ADDITIVITY_NOT_SUPPORTED; both A and D seed-mean Locked MAE are at least 0.003 lower than DCC-L seed-mean; and A-vs-D is not reliable (|A-D| seed-mean < 0.003 or not all per-seed A-D differences are positive)
rules.INCONCLUSIVE: everything else (seed/tail dependent, or all effects < 0.003)
rules.local_path_collapse: for both A seeds, std(w^T S) < 0.05 * std(psi(G)) AND zeroing w^T S (predicting psi(G) alone) changes Locked MAE by < 0.001; any seed meeting this is reported
rules.official_test_conversion: only if A beats historical DCC-L on Locked by >= 0.005 robustly may the report discuss the distance to official-test 0.05x; no conversion of internal Locked gain into an official-test score is allowed
